## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the use case and why the current
behavior is insufficient.

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include proposed API
shapes or package boundaries if relevant.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Additional context

Add any other context, links, or examples here. Note whether you are willing to
contribute the change.
